issues_found.description: reqctl tool-vs-spec drift: tools/reqctl.py VALID_STATUSES lacks DESIGNED (set is DRAFT/VALIDATED/PENDING/IN_PROGRESS/IMPLEMENTED/TESTED/RELEASED/UNTRACKED/INFORMATIONAL/DEPRECATED), so CODE-DESIGNER used IN_PROGRESS as closest legal status. Verified. Disposition: acceptable to carry — status is bookkeeping, already noted in docs/requirements.yaml notes for DDL-04/OBP-04/ORD-03/VLD-04. Recommend DOC-UPDATER/ORCH file a MINOR issue to add DESIGNED to reqctl.py (or correct AGENT_SYSTEM.md).

VLD-04 event_type_registry seeding required by BACKEND-DEV: DEFINITION_VALIDATED and DEFINITION_VALIDATION_FAILED are absent from every migration (grep across migrations/** returns nothing); migration 1152 seeds only the EXECUTION_* family. Verified. Disposition: acceptable to carry — the VLD-04 migration YAML carries an explicit IMPLEMENTER NOTE telling BACKEND-DEV to add a CUSTOM seeding block (ON CONFLICT (name, schema_version) DO NOTHING, retention_class='retain_forever', per PAR-03 AC1) to the generated SQL before final COMMIT, so the requirement is unambiguous. BACKEND-DEV MUST seed both types or persistVerdict's append fails the ES-05 registry check.

OBP-04 depends on unimplemented OBP-01/02/03 (all status DRAFT in docs/requirements.yaml). Verified. Disposition: acceptable to carry — OBP-04's own ACs (gate hysteresis, escalations, per-tenant keying) are fully testable via the pure `decide` function plus plat_outbox_gate without OBP-01/02/03 present; the design fixes the gate interface now so future modules consume it without signature change. Only callers in this batch are its own tests and drainer cadence wiring.

NEW (found by validator): OBP-04's migration YAML lacks the event-seeding IMPLEMENTER NOTE that VLD-04's carries. EXECUTION_OUTBOX_GATE_OPENED is absent from every migration (grep across migrations/** returns nothing), yet the OBP-04 migration YAML header only says 'This migration only creates the table shape'; the seeding requirement lives only in the Type E design's Open question #1. Disposition: acceptable to carry — the design names the event and the registry-gate consequence, so BACKEND-DEV reading both files will not miss it; recommend CODE-DESIGNER add the matching IMPLEMENTER NOTE to the OBP-04 migration YAML for parity during implementation.
